# Birtingur

Birtingur is a self-service display advertising platform for the Icelandic
market, built for long-tail niche content creators (e.g. food and lifestyle
blogs) rather than premium publishers. Publishers register a site, declare
its content categories, and embed an ad slot; advertisers buy by category and
budget instead of picking individual sites, and the platform spreads
impressions across every publisher site in that category. All money is in
ISK (integer krona, no decimals); Icelandic VAT is 24%.

## Pricing

- Flat CPM: 550 ISK per 1,000 impressions, applied to every ad category.
  There is no auction and no bidding — the price is the same regardless of
  category or region.
- No setup fees, no monthly fees. A campaign's remaining budget is enforced
  server-side and the campaign stops serving automatically once it is spent.
- Publishers keep 80% of gross ad revenue (a 20% platform fee); payouts run
  monthly with a 5,000 ISK minimum (balances below that roll to the next
  month).
- VAT (24%) is charged only on the platform's service fee, not on the full
  wallet top-up, and is itemized on an electronic invoice.

## Publisher flow

1. Register an account and add your site.
2. Declare the site's content categories (e.g. food, travel, tech).
3. Create an ad slot; the platform gives you one HTML/JS snippet to embed.
4. Approve or reject individual ads in a per-site approval queue if you want
   manual control, on top of automatic content screening.
5. Get paid monthly once your balance clears the payout minimum.

## Advertiser flow

New self-serve advertiser signup is currently closed (waitlist only) while
existing advertisers are onboarded manually; the flow below is what runs once
an account exists:

1. Create an advertiser account.
2. Pick target categories, region, and a monthly budget — the platform shows
   an impression forecast for that combination before you pay.
3. Provide creatives: paste your website URL and the built-in AI creative
   tool writes ad copy and renders banners in every IAB size your target
   slots use, or upload your own PNG/JPEG/WebP creatives. AI-generated
   creatives go through the same content-safety review and approval flow as
   uploaded ones, and you always confirm the final copy yourself. AI
   generation has daily caps per advertiser (currently 20 copy generations
   and 10 render generations per day).
4. Top up the wallet (card payment) and activate the campaign. The campaign
   stops automatically when the budget is spent.

Standard ad sizes: 728x90 (Leaderboard), 300x250 (Medium Rectangle),
300x600 (Half Page), 320x100 (Mobile Banner), 980x120 (Billboard IS).

## MCP server for AI agents

Birtingur runs an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server at mcp.birtingur.app,
scoped per API key:

- Publisher-scoped keys: register and manage ad slots, fetch embed
  snippets, set content policy, handle creative approvals, read stats.
- Advertiser-scoped keys: browse categories and inventory forecasts, check
  wallet balance, and buy category campaigns using creatives that have
  already been approved (the MCP server cannot create or upload new
  creatives).

Agentic purchasing is opt-in per API key, with a configurable monthly
spending cap; any purchase above an owner-configured auto-approve threshold
is created pending and must be approved by the account owner in the
dashboard. An API key can never top up the wallet, raise its own limits, or
approve its own pending purchase — only a human, signed into the dashboard,
can do that.

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer ak_...` (an API key created in the dashboard).
